predict.question: You design a code where every message is a string of five positions, each independently set to 0 or 1. How many different full strings can you make?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Binary representation combines two possibilities per position.
modelBoundary: Four bits permit {A}; five permit {B}. Each existing pattern receives two distinct extensions, so one extra position doubles the count.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This exact count assumes two usable states per position. Carries, circuit speed and storage reliability are not modeled.
